name: audio_cepstral
expr: c1 = cepstralCoefficients(S); c1_1 = c1(1); c1_2 = c1(2); c1_4 = c1(4); c1_6 = c1(6); c2 = cepstralCoefficients(S2); c2_21 = c2(2,1); c2_22 = c2(2,2); c2_24 = c2(2,4); c2_25 = c2(2,5); [mc, md, mdd] = mfcc(xs, fs); mfcc_R = size(mc, 1); mfcc_C = size(mc, 2);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycle D: cepstralCoefficients (bit-equal vs MATLAB R2025b — DCT-II unitary matrix from createDCTmatrix.m + log10 rectification, output shape M×NumCoeffs). Tested on single-frame and multi-frame synthetic 8-band spectra. mfcc shape pinned (NumFrames × NumCoeffs+1 with LogEnergy='append' default). KNOWN GAPs: mfcc/gtcc EXACT bit-equality deferred — MATLAB uses |FFT| magnitude into a custom internal designMelFilterBank with different normalization than our melSpectrogram (cycle C uses |FFT|^2 power). v1 ships shape-correct + approximate values via the existing melSpectrogram pipeline. gtcc currently aliases to mfcc (gammatone ERB filterbank deferred to v2 — needs IIR gammatone shape, not triangular). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship cepstralCoefficients/mfcc/gtcc in core (Audio package only).
